rationale: Weiru brings product marketing expertise from ByteDance's creator-focused platforms (TikTok, CapCut) while Ethan is a founding research scientist at Moondream working on computer vision and consumer AI—complementary skills for building AI products that reach creators and consumers. Their shared focus on consumer-AI and creator economy gives them natural context to explore how ML research translates into market-ready products.
intro_message: Weiru @Creative Community, meet Ethan reid — he's doing founding research on computer vision and consumer AI at Moondream, and your product marketing background at ByteDance could offer valuable perspective on bringing AI research to creators and consumers.
